# Fornax Labs

> Fornax Labs is an agentic AI platform for advisory and professional firms: mutual fund distributors, insurance brokers, CA and tax firms, and law firms. Its agents pick up client requests from the channels a firm already uses (email, WhatsApp, web forms and business tools), work out what is needed, do the routine work, and bring in a person for anything sensitive. Every run is tracked end to end.

- Website: https://fornaxlabs.xyz/
- Contact: sales@fornaxlabs.xyz

## The platform

- [Fornax Labs home](https://fornaxlabs.xyz/): The whole site on one page: the platform, a live Sugamkar demo, who it's for, rules and approvals, trust and privacy, the pilot application form and an FAQ.
- Channels: email is live; WhatsApp and web forms are rolling out with pilot customers; business tools connect through integrations.
- Mutual fund distributors and wealth advisors: SIP changes, redemptions and switches, KYC, nominee and address updates, statement and capital gains requests, complaints (pilots open, via Sugamkar).
- Insurance brokers: new quote requests, renewal reminders, claim intimations, endorsements and policy documents (coming next).
- CA and tax firms: filing requests, tax notices with due dates, document collection, fee follow-ups (coming next).
- Law firms: new matter intake with conflict checks, hearing and court date updates, document requests, client updates and fee follow-ups (coming next).
- Customisation: custom rules, routing to people or teams, and approval flows, without code.
- Oversight: every step, tool call and decision is logged; sensitive actions are routed for approval; time saved, success rate and spend are tracked per agent.

## Sugamkar (first product)

- [Sugamkar](https://fornaxlabs.xyz/#demo): An agent for advisors, distributors and service firms. It reads client messages from email, WhatsApp and web forms, recognises each request (for example an SIP change, a renewal or a tax notice), and puts the work on one list with an assignee and a status. Personally identifiable information (PII) and sensitive personal information (SPI) are masked before AI processing, and nothing is sent without approval. Open for pilots with mutual fund distributors; apply at https://fornaxlabs.xyz/#pilot.
